---
title: "About"
---

This site uses the U.S. Census Bureau's American Community Survey (ACS)
5-year estimates to explore median household income in Florida's counties.
The series runs from 2010 through 2023; dollar values are not adjusted for
inflation, and the 5-year estimates overlap.

## Reproduce the analysis

The download step is separate from the website:

1. Configure your Census API key for `tidycensus` in your local R environment.
   Do not save the key in this repository.
2. Run `Rscript data-raw/download_income.R` to create the county income CSV
   and map geometry in `data/`.
3. Run `quarto render` to rebuild the website. `index.qmd` reads those files
   to draw the map and interactive chart.

The downloader requests ACS table `B19013` (median household income) for
all Florida counties. The margin of error is included in the CSV; the map
colors use the latest estimate, 2023.
